question: Under the federal US Coast Guard rule (where no state rule applies), children under what age must wear a life jacket while a recreational boat is underway?

false_option: Only children under 6 must wear a life jacket
true_claim_text: children under 13 must wear a life jacket underway

source: US Coast Guard federal interim rule (33 CFR 175.15): children under 13 must wear a USCG-approved life jacket while a recreational vessel is underway, unless below deck or in an enclosed cabin.
